observations.behavior: Adds a self-executing IIFE with DOM-based confirmation guards, typed-project-ID prompts, and a pageshow handler to restore disabled submit buttons after bfcache restoration.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds client-side confirmation and typed-ID verification before submitting a POST request that permanently deletes session recording data, preventing accidental deletion and double-submitting. No server-side or database changes are shown in this hunk.
